name: BizerOS GTD
description: Self-hosted, local-first Getting Things Done (GTD) app for the BizerOS stack. Capture, clarify, organize, reflect, engage — without sending your tasks to a third-party cloud.
short_desc: Local-first GTD task manager with self-hosted sync.
author: BizerOS (fork of Mindwtr by Dongda Li)

form_fields.label: Cloud auth token
form_fields.hint: Bearer token shared between the PWA and any REST/MCP clients. Leave blank to auto-generate.

form_fields.label: Public PWA URL (CORS origin)
form_fields.hint: The URL where you will reach the PWA from your browser. Used by the cloud sync server to validate CORS.
